summary: Frontend-only UI testing for AI-generated per-company Finance Categories (iteration 69). All primary flows PASS. Ledger /ledger → Expenses 'Add expense' dialog category dropdown lists tenant-specific textile categories: ['— Auto —','Raw Materials','Dyeing & Finishing','Power & Utilities','Machine Maintenance','Labour Wages','Packing Materials','Freight & Logistics','Sales Commissions','Factory Rent','Quality Testing','Administrative Costs','Other'] — NOT the old generic list. Saving an expense with 'Raw Materials' persisted and shows in Expenses table with correct category chip. Assets tab 'Add asset' dropdown lists tenant asset categories: ['Weaving Machinery','Dyeing Equipment','Cutting & Stitching Machines','Vehicles','Computers & IT','Factory Fixtures','Other'] and saving an asset with 'Weaving Machinery' persisted correctly. Settings /settings shows the new 'Finance Categories' card (data-testid=settings-finance-categories-card) with fc-expense/fc-asset editable chip groups. Add-chip → edit input → Save Categories persists after full page reload. Regenerate-with-AI (real Claude call) completed in ~5s and refreshed chips with 12 industry-appropriate textile categories (toast success shown). Regression: Revenue tab still renders Billed/Received/Outstanding KPIs and Overview shows Revenue/Total Spend/Net Profit KPIs.
critical_code_review_comments: FinanceCategoriesEditor: chip 'Remove' Trash button has no data-testid. Adding fc-expense-item-<i>-delete and fc-asset-item-<i>-delete would make delete flows testable without relying on nth-button selectors.

Save toast text after regenerate reads 'Finance categories saved' — a bit misleading; consider 'AI regenerated your finance categories' consistently. (Current code sets that message but observed toast said 'saved' — the follow-up refreshTenant may fire another toast. Minor UX polish.)
Ledger add-expense/add-asset category dropdowns are native <select>. Consistent with income-status but different from other shadcn Selects in the codebase — consider unifying.
seed_data_creation: Created and cleaned up 1 TEST_EXP_* expense, 1 TEST_AST_* asset, 1 TESTCAT* custom finance category chip. All removed at end of test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tenant categories are stored on tenant.finance_categories and surfaced via GET /api/ledger/summary → .categories / .asset_categories. Native <select> testids: expense-category, asset-category (set via page.select_option, not role=option). Settings testids: settings-finance-categories-card, fc-expense, fc-asset, fc-expense-add, fc-asset-add, fc-expense-input-<i>, fc-asset-input-<i>, fc-save, fc-regenerate. Regenerate call to Claude completed in ~5s; allow up to 20-25s to be safe. Delete Trash button on chip has no data-testid — use `[data-testid="fc-expense-item-<i>"] button`.
rca of the issue: N/A — feature implemented correctly by main agent; no bugs found.
